overview.summary: A romantic weekend getaway to Goa for a couple, blending relaxed beach time with cultural sights and tasty Goan cuisine.
overview.best_time_note: Late September offers pleasant temperatures, fewer crowds and the tail‑end of the monsoon, perfect for beach walks and sightseeing.
